answer: Follow the money downstream. A farm only profits once its clones' rewards pool in one wallet, so rewards vest for 10 epochs while the ledger traces where they flow. When payouts from many identities meet within a few hops, like each river branch draining into one lagoon, that lagoon is paid as one identity: the largest share plus 10% of the rest. Illustrative: 50 clones earning 100 POA each net 590, not 5,000. Staying apart means 50 separate cash-out paths, a cost per clone. The fable of strangers ends where their streams meet. Catch: shared exchange deposit wallets need an exemption list.
